{{Quote|Thank you for dealing with him. If there is some way I could repay you I would be happy to do you a favor. I have a little money—perhaps you would like some food and drink?|Zukata|<ref name="Trouble Brewing">{{FFG|story=Trouble Brewing|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook}}</ref>}}
'''Zukata''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked for an organization making atlas or [[Droid/Legends|droid]] upgrades in the period of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Zukata came to the [[Rii Jenks Cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] in order to find her brother, [[Godon Netakka]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] on the trail of the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Bandin Dobah]]. There, she encountered a group of off-world adventurers who had been hired to recover the droid [[R4-W9]], which had been stolen by Dobah. They agreed to help her find her brother.<ref name="Trouble Brewing" />
